decisions.reason: Location-based margin analysis uses the maintained market-data databases, has its own web page and adds analytical value for utilities at low marginal cost.
Gas tariff comparison is close to the core offer and runs on the same daily updated data, so it costs little to keep and supports the platform strategy.
The regional electricity tariff calculator is core-adjacent, presented on its own page, and serves steady demand from suppliers.
The energy tariff calculator line is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with C, but it is more likely to be folded into the central platform than withdrawn outright.
Site-specific tariff comparison is close to the established offer, and its models are cheap to maintain on shared data despite low website prominence.
